zh.title: 扫码器
zh.summary: 相机实时扫码识别，环境不支持或权限受限时自动降级为手动输入。

en.title: Scanner
en.summary: Camera-based code scanning with automatic manual-input fallback.

desc.zh: 在场=请求相机并开始预览识别
desc.en: Present: request the camera and start preview scanning

desc.zh: 在场=显示手动输入行；无相机/无权限/出错时自动降级为该模式
desc.en: Present: show the manual input row; auto fallback when the camera is unavailable

desc.zh: 识别成功时派发（含手动提交）；同一 value+format 指纹不重复派发
desc.en: Fired on a successful decode (incl. manual submit); the same value+format fingerprint is not re-fired

desc.zh: 环境不支持/权限被拒/相机异常时派发，同一 code 每次激活会话只派发一次
desc.en: Fired when unsupported / permission denied / camera error; once per activation session per code
